description: Exploit and add margin. On the E025 incumbent (5x24 + 2x28 + 4x32 px, 2/3/3 net, Muon at batch 1536 with momentum 0.655, Turbo preconditioning plus 2 NS steps, CUDA graphs per resolution, Lookahead and triangle), raise the Muon peak lr by 1.25x, from 0.205 to 0.256, and change nothing else. The SGD groups, momentum, schedule shape and resolution schedule stay fixed. The LR lives in the GPU schedule tensor, so the graphs need no recapture. Rationale: the E024 note says Turbo preconditioning shrank the effective update on the big layers by about 1/3, and the inherited Hiverge lr was tuned for a 3/3/3 CIFAR-10 net without resizing. Run salt 0 (official) and also salt 1, so the comparison is against the pooled E025/E027 estimate of 0.7533 and not E025's single draw of 0.7539.
